name: dsh-client-ui-quote
description: Select text in the DSH transcript, a file preview or the terminal to quote it into the composer or into a side thread's composer, Kimi-Code style (comment / add to conversation / side chat), with Alt+Q/C/B, a jump back to the quoted source, a searchable quote list page that exports as Markdown, one-click back-flow of a side thread's conclusion, and revisions of a sent quote that mark the old capsule as superseded. The quoted text itself is editable in the comment box (trim a selection, correct a revision's wording), a selection from the file preview or the terminal travels to the model as a fenced code block carrying its file path and line range, and a per-quote reply toggle has the model answer quote by quote, each 「引用N」 label in the reply becoming a badge linked back to the quote. The quoted sentence keeps a highlight and ordinal in its source message, a 引用 ×N bar above the composer lists the draft's quotes, and the sent ref line names the turn and role it came from in readable words. Selections in a diff or per-turn change panel are quotable as code with their file path and line range, and the quote list can insert a multi-selected set into the composer in one action; it also works as a review workbench, marking quotes open/resolved, tagging and filtering them, and batch-resolving or batch-inserting the ticked ones.
author: BangBang-03
